content.title: Here's exactly what time XO, Kitty season 3 comes out on Netflix
content.text: 1 April 2026, 11:28 | Updated: 1 April 2026, 11:32 Here's exactly what time XO, Kitty season 3 comes out on Netflix. Picture: Netflix When does XO, Kitty season 3 come out on Netflix? Everything you need to know about the release time in the US, UK and more. Matchmakers assemble! XO, Kitty is hours from returning but what time does XO, Kitty season 3 come out on Netflix?Ever since XO, Kitty season 2 came out in 2025, fans have been desperate to learn what happens next after the major cliffhanger in the finale. In the episode, Kitty decides to tell Min Ho how she feels about him but Min Ho then tells her that he's going on tour with his brother and Kitty asks to join him on tour instead of saying how she actually feels. So does Kitty go on tour? Are Kitty and Min Ho endgame? Is there any hope left for Kitty and Yuri shippers? Luckily, it isn't long until fans get answers. XO, Kitty season 3 drops worldwide on April 2nd but the time it becomes available on Netflix will depend on what time zone you live in. Scroll down for a list of international release times. Watch the XO, Kitty season 3 trailer XO, Kitty season 3 release time: Here's when it comes out in your countryXO, Kitty season 3 drops on Netflix on Thursday April 2nd at 12AM Pacific Time (PT). The exact time that it comes out in your country will depend on where you live in the world and what your time zone is. For viewers in the UK, the episodes will become available to stream on Netflix at 8AM (GMT) on Thursday April 2nd. For viewers across Europe, the episodes will drop at 9AM (CET) on Thursday April 2nd.Here's a full list of release times for various other timezones:United States (PT) - 9PM (April 1st)United States (ET) - 12AMCanada (Vancouver) - 9PM (April 1st)Canada (Toronto) - 12AMBrazil (Rio De Janiero) - 4AMUnited Kingdom BST) - 8AMEurope (CET) - 9AMSouth Africa (Cape Town, Central Africa Time) - 9AMIndia (New Delhi) - 12:30PMIndonesia (Jakarta) - 2PMPhilippines (Manila) - 3PMHong Kong - 3PMSingapore - 3PMAustralia - 3PM (Perth), 6PM (Sydney)Japan (Tokyo) - 4PMNew Zealand (Auckland) - 8PMFind even more time zones here. Picture: Netflix What will happen in XO, Kitty season 3?The full plot of XO, Kitty season 3 is currently under wraps but Netflix have revealed that it will follow Kitty during her final year at KISS.
